import os,re,json,itertools
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def segs(inp,bg):
    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0]); out=[]
    for c in sorted(set(sum(inp,[]))-{bg}):
        ps=sorted((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]==c)
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        # slope
        (a,b),(e,f)=ps[0],ps[-1]
        g=__import__('math').gcd(abs(e-a),abs(f-b))
        dr,dc=(e-a)//g,(f-b)//g
        if abs(dr)!=1 or abs(dc)!=1: continue
        out.append((c,ps,dr,dc))
    return out

def extend(inp,bg,mode):
    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for c,ps,dr,dc in segs(inp,bg):
        n=len(ps)
        # candidates: directions +/- (dr,dc); score by freedom & distance from other colors
        others=[p for cc,pps,*_ in segs(inp,bg) if cc!=c for p in pps]
        cm=(sum(p[0] for p in ps)/n,sum(p[1] for p in ps)/n)
        opts=[]
        for sgn in (1,-1):
            dy,dx=sgn*dr,sgn*dc
            # cost: proximity to others along this ray
            cost=0; y,x=int(cm[0]),int(cm[1])
            free=0
            while True:
                y+=dy;x+=dx
                if not(0<=y<h and 0<=x<w): break
                if inp[y][x]!=bg: cost+=100; break
                free+=1
            opts.append((free,cost,sgn))
        if mode=='maxfree': best=max(opts,key=lambda o:o[0])
        elif mode=='mincost': best=min(opts,key=lambda o:o[1])
        else: best=max(opts)  # lexicographic
        _,_,sgn=best
        y,x=int(cm[0]),int(cm[1])
        while True:
            ny,nx=y+sgn*dr,x+sgn*dc
            if not(0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w) or inp[ny][nx]!=bg: break
            out[ny][nx]=c; y,x=ny,nx
    return out

for mode in ['maxfree','mincost']:
    allok=True
    for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
        r=extend(G[k+' input'],G[k+' input'][0][0],mode)==G[k+' output']

    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0]);bg=inp[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]

            if not(0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w) or inp[ny][nx]!=bg: break
            out[ny][nx]=c; y,x=ny,nx
    return out
